description: This Java source file defines the OrderMapList class, which implements a method operation for ordering a list of maps based on specified criteria within the mini-lang framework of the OFBiz project. It includes logic for validation, constructing a comparator based on order-by elements, and executing the sorting operation.

classes.name: OrderMapList
classes.description: Implements a method operation to sort a list of maps based on specified ordering criteria within the mini-lang framework.

classes.name: OrderMapListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of OrderMapList from XML elements.

methods.name: OrderMapList
methods.description: Constructor that validates and initializes the OrderMapList based on an XML element and the current simple method context. Sets up the list accessor and comparator.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the sorting operation on the list retrieved from the environment map using the configured flexible map accessor. Sorts the list if comparator is configured.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the OrderMapList instance, mainly for debugging.
